scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,GUEST,WEB -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev:guest --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.dev:preview: concurrently -k -n PREVIEW,GUEST,WEB -c blue,magenta,green "node --env-file=server/.env.test --import tsx server/src/index.ts" "node --env-file=server/.env.test --import tsx server/src/guestIndex.ts" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
